lesson.meaning: To prevent someone or something from being part of a group, activity, or place.
examples: Please make sure we don't exclude anyone from the team meeting invitation.
The new project scope will exclude tasks that are not directly related to our main goal.
We need to exclude any personal bias when evaluating job candidates.
It's important not to exclude different perspectives when making a big decision.
The software update will exclude older operating systems, so check your compatibility.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'EX' in 'exclude' like 'exit'. When you exclude something, you're essentially showing it the 'exit door' from a group or situation.
